reason_for_revision: Prevent cross-window conflation of historical acceptance, production activation, daily ranking, and Phase2 daily freshness.

phase2_daily_freshness.prohibited_inference: Do not infer Phase2 daily completion from daily ranking PASS or production ACTIVE.

invariants: Historical PASS is a fixed acceptance fact and cannot be automatically downgraded by missing/older Phase2 daily-completion fields.
Production ACTIVE means automation configuration verified, not that the next or every daily run succeeded.
Daily rank PASS is not Phase2 daily-completion PASS.
Phase2 daily freshness must be stated with the exact market and dated receipt, or NOT_RECORDED; never use a generic unscoped PASS/FAIL.
Do not demand repeated historical validation, historical downloads, BASE mutation, or full Phase2 replay solely due to daily freshness lag.
Do not fabricate or backdate Phase2 completion fields to make them match daily ranking.
note: The historical PASS and production activation remain accepted; any latest-day Phase2 completion is a separate live datum.
